comparisons.name: brands
comparisons.sql: SELECT brand_id, user_id, brand_name, brand_personality, voice_description, visual_style_preferences, target_audience, created_at, updated_at, tagline, is_demo, brand_type, campaign_profile, real_estate_profile, geo_targeting, demo_tier, website_url, facebook_page_url, instagram_url, linkedin_url, youtube_url, tiktok_url, google_business_url, facebook_page_id, ad_link_url FROM brands WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY brand_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: social_posts_all
comparisons.sql: SELECT post_id, brand_id, platform, post_content, scheduled_time, published_time, status, engagement_metrics, external_post_id, created_at, updated_at, calendar_id, publish_attempts, source, image_url, video_url, proof_run_key FROM social_posts WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY post_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: social_posts_unpublished
comparisons.sql: SELECT post_id, brand_id, platform, post_content, scheduled_time, published_time, status, engagement_metrics, external_post_id, created_at, updated_at, calendar_id, publish_attempts, source, image_url, video_url, proof_run_key FROM social_posts WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) AND status::text<>'published' ORDER BY post_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: social_posts_scheduled
comparisons.sql: SELECT post_id, brand_id, platform, post_content, scheduled_time, published_time, status, engagement_metrics, external_post_id, created_at, updated_at, calendar_id, publish_attempts, source, image_url, video_url, proof_run_key FROM social_posts WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) AND status::text='scheduled' ORDER BY scheduled_time ASC, post_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: social_posts_consented_h1
comparisons.sql: SELECT post_id, brand_id, platform, post_content, scheduled_time, published_time, status, engagement_metrics, external_post_id, created_at, updated_at, calendar_id, publish_attempts, source, image_url, video_url, proof_run_key FROM social_posts sp WHERE sp.brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_tasks t WHERE t.task_type='social_publish' AND t.source_type='social_post' AND t.source_id=sp.post_id::text AND t.meta ? 'consent') ORDER BY sp.scheduled_time ASC, sp.post_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: remaining_consented_scheduled_specimen
comparisons.sql: SELECT post_id, brand_id, platform, post_content, scheduled_time, published_time, status, engagement_metrics, external_post_id, created_at, updated_at, calendar_id, publish_attempts, source, image_url, video_url, proof_run_key FROM social_posts WHERE post_id=$1::uuid ORDER BY post_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: content_calendars
comparisons.sql: SELECT calendar_id, brand_id, month, year, posting_frequency, content_theme, status, created_at, updated_at FROM content_calendars WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY calendar_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: agent_tasks
comparisons.sql: SELECT task_id, brand_id, user_id, task_type, source_type, source_id, attempt, status, title, external_ref, proof_id, last_error, meta, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_tasks WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY task_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: agent_task_events
comparisons.sql: SELECT event_id, task_id, actor, from_status, to_status, meta, created_at FROM agent_task_events e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_tasks t WHERE t.task_id=e.task_id AND t.brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[])) ORDER BY e.event_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: external_actions
comparisons.sql: SELECT action_id, idempotency_key, attempt, provider, action, task_id, proof_id, brand_id, user_id, status, classification, error, external_ref, meta, dedup_count, alerted_at, reconciled_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at FROM external_actions WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY action_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: external_proofs
comparisons.sql: SELECT proof_id, run_key, provider, action, external_id, brand_id, user_id, environment, evidence, verified_at, created_at FROM external_proofs WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY proof_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: campaigns
comparisons.sql: SELECT campaign_id, brand_id, user_id, campaign_name, budget, cost_per_lead, conversion_rate, ad_creative_variations, launch_date, created_at, updated_at, facebook_campaign_id, facebook_adset_id, status, facebook_creative_id, facebook_ad_id, last_verified_at, last_verify_error, activation_requested_at FROM campaigns WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY campaign_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: ad_creatives
comparisons.sql: SELECT creative_id, brand_id, campaign_goal, creative_concept, status, launched_package, facebook_campaign_id, facebook_adset_id, campaign_id, performance_data, created_at, updated_at FROM ad_creatives WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY creative_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: ad_spend_audit
comparisons.sql: SELECT audit_id, campaign_id, brand_id, actor_user_id, action, result, brand_cap_cents_at_time, platform_cap_cents_at_time, campaign_budget_cents, committed_live_cents_at_time, denial_reason, error_message, created_at FROM ad_spend_audit WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY audit_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: ad_spend_caps
comparisons.sql: SELECT cap_id, brand_id, daily_cap_cents, set_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM ad_spend_caps WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY cap_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: setup_sessions_lifecycle
comparisons.sql: SELECT session_id, user_id, status, completed_steps, current_field, interview_complete, consent_granted, consent_at, brand_id, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, executing, executing_at, started_at, paused_at, resumed_at, discovery_session_id FROM setup_sessions WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) OR user_id=ANY($2::uuid[]) ORDER BY session_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: guided_setup_progress
comparisons.sql: SELECT user_id, current_step, connections, created_at, updated_at FROM guided_setup_progress WHERE user_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY user_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: armed_publish_authorizations
comparisons.sql: SELECT authorization_id, user_id, brand_id, post_id, content_hash, destination_page_id, destination_bound_at, consent_copy_version, consent_captured_at, armed_at, status, invalidation_reason, claimed_at, consumed_at, disarmed_at, execution_failed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM armed_publish_authorizations WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY authorization_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: onboarding_first_win_celebrations
comparisons.sql: SELECT celebration_claim_id, proof_id, user_id, brand_id, provider, claimed_at FROM onboarding_first_win_celebrations WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY celebration_claim_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: social_accounts_binding
comparisons.sql: SELECT account_id, brand_id, platform, platform_username, connection_status, created_at, updated_at, (credentials_encrypted IS NOT NULL) AS credentials_present FROM social_accounts WHERE brand_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY account_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: api_integrations_binding
comparisons.sql: SELECT integration_id, user_id, platform, connection_status, created_at, updated_at, account_ref, facebook_ad_accounts, facebook_pages, page_ref, (api_token_encrypted IS NOT NULL) AS api_token_present, (facebook_page_tokens IS NOT NULL) AS facebook_page_tokens_present FROM api_integrations WHERE user_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY integration_id::text ASC

comparisons.name: google_integrations_binding
comparisons.sql: SELECT id, user_id, scope, token_expiry, connection_status, created_at, updated_at, (access_token_encrypted IS NOT NULL) AS access_token_present, (refresh_token_encrypted IS NOT NULL) AS refresh_token_present FROM google_integrations WHERE user_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY id::text ASC
